reviews.summary: ICNT has a fresh supply-overhang risk: a ~19.7M-token cliff unlock occurred November 3, 2026, and another similarly sized release is scheduled for December 3. This is directly relevant after the current sharp, high-volume move.
materialRisks: A scheduled ~19.7M ICNT unlock—about 2.8% of total supply and roughly 5.8% of market capitalization—occurred on November 3, 2026, five days before this snapshot; newly transferable investor/insider-associated supply can still reach markets. ([terminalnox.com](https://terminalnox.com/unlocks/ICNT?utm_source=openai))

The next scheduled release is ~19.7M ICNT on December 3, 2026, continuing a monthly cliff-unlock cadence; tracker allocation data identifies investor, insider/team, and community-related recipients. ([app.tokenomics.com](https://app.tokenomics.com/tokenomics/impossible-cloud-network/unlocks?utm_source=openai))

facts.fact: Asset identity is confirmed as Impossible Cloud Network Token (ICNT); Bitvavo lists an ICNT/EUR spot market. ([coinpaprika.com](https://coinpaprika.com/coin/icnt-impossible-cloud-network?utm_source=openai))

The project’s official tokenomics documentation describes vesting allocations for Team, Investors, DevCo, EcoDev Fund, and Partner Fund; the external unlock data is consistent with ongoing scheduled releases. ([docs.icn.global](https://docs.icn.global/icn-economics/tokenomics/vesting-schedule?utm_source=openai))
No corroborated fresh project-specific exploit, network outage, delisting, or regulatory action was identified in the reviewed current sources.
